data.summary:
With **ASURYANI** as your [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction), as each [battle round](vsdata:core-rule/start-of-battle-round) begins, you get Battle Focus tokens by [battle size](vsdata:core-rule/select-battle-size): 2 in Incursion, 4 in Strike Force or 6 in Onslaught. Tokens you have not spent are lost as the battle round ends.

Whenever the trigger of an Agile Manoeuvre below happens, you can spend a token to have an eligible unit carry it out. A unit with this ability is eligible while it has carried out no Agile Manoeuvre yet in that phase. Unless a manoeuvre says otherwise, each one can be triggered only once per phase. The Agile Manoeuvres are:

- **Swift as the Wind**: whenever an eligible unit of yours is picked to make a [normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), [advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) or [fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back), its models get +2" M for the rest of the phase. This one can be triggered several times in a phase, by a new unit for each use.
- **Flitting Shadows**: whenever an eligible unit of yours is picked to make a normal move, advance move or fall-back move, declares a charge, or is placed on the battlefield, enemy units cannot shoot it with the [Fire Overwatch](vsdata:ability/core.fire-overwatch) Stratagem for the rest of the turn.
- **Star Engines**: whenever an eligible **VEHICLE** unit of yours is picked for an advance move, its ranged weapons get **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)** for the rest of the turn.
- **Sudden Strike**: after an eligible unit of yours ends a [charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move), each [pile-in move](vsdata:core-rule/pile-in-move) or [consolidation move](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move) by its models can be up to 6" long rather than 3", for the rest of the turn.
- **Opportunity Seized**: after an enemy unit finishes a fall-back move, an eligible unit of yours, not a **TITANIC** unit, that began the phase in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of it can be moved up to D6+1" with a normal move.
- **Fade Back**: after an enemy unit shoots in [your opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), an eligible unit of yours, not a **TITANIC** unit, that was hit by any of its attacks can be moved up to D6+1" with a normal move.

Swift as the Wind.trigger: eligible friendly unit chosen to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move

Flitting Shadows.trigger: eligible friendly unit chosen to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge
Flitting Shadows.effect: enemy units cannot shoot with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem at it

Star Engines.trigger: eligible friendly VEHICLE unit selected to make an Advance move
Star Engines.weapons: ranged weapons equipped by the unit

Sudden Strike.trigger: eligible friendly unit selected to fight

Opportunity Seized.trigger: an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move
Opportunity Seized.eligibleUnit: non-TITANIC, began the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit

Fade Back.trigger: opponent's Shooting phase, right after an enemy unit has shot
Fade Back.eligibleUnit: non-TITANIC, hit by one or more of those attacks
